description: Query token cost for entities of a project, optionally over a UTC date range. Returns totalsById (tokens and USD per filter ID) and breakdownById (per filter ID: spend by testing stage, by model with input/output/cache tokens, and by test case).

endDateKey.description: Inclusive end day, UTC, MM-DD-YYYY. Provide with startDateKey, or omit both for all time.

filterIds.description: Entity UUIDs matching filterType (project / use case / test case / test script / action script). For the whole project, pass filterType 'project' and the project ID.

startDateKey.description: Inclusive start day, UTC, MM-DD-YYYY. Provide with endDateKey, or omit both for all time.

name: muggle-remote-report-cost-query
